description: Hi neighbor,Today is my birthday. I am spending it at work, which feels about right for this stage of a campaign.Our campaign needs your help!In 64 days this district picks a state representative. It is an open seat. The Minnesota House is tied 67 to 67, and 68 is a majority. The last time this seat was on the ballot it came down to 510 votes across 15 precincts. That is 34 votes a precinct.A margin that size gets closed at the door, one conversation at a time. I do not need a present. I need do
